versions.changelog:
- Initial release of BlackSwan (now blackclaw) skill for real-time crypto risk intelligence.
- Provides two main tools: Flare (15-min precursor detection) and Core (60-min market context analysis).
- No API key is required for the latest analysis; upgrade available for custom requests.
- Detailed API endpoints with sample commands and response formats.
- Clear documentation on interpreting risk levels and error handling.
